description: This PHP class 'NotIn' defines a validation rule that checks if a given input is not present in a specified array of values (haystack). It is part of a validation rules set within the OrangeHRM core API.

classes.name: NotIn
classes.description: A validation rule class that ensures a value is not within a specified list of values.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the haystack array and comparison mode.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Checks if the input value is not in the haystack array using the specified comparison mode.
